second_order: rallying people and choosing a foothold
theme_note: These passages all work on getting a Celtic mark started or restarted: asking for people, estimating the numbers needed, joining, requesting access, offering labour, choosing usable coordinates, and carrying the proposal into next year. What varies is whether the contribution recruits, supplies labour, or selects a place or time.

second_order: working out space and help with neighbours
theme_note: These turns handle overlapping canvas claims with people identified through BVB, Zia and Bruins: proposing cooperation, objecting to damage, allocating blame, easing the objection, and offering conditional help. What varies is alliance-making, boundary protection, reassurance, and help.

second_order: showing and cheering something Celtic on r/place
theme_note: These passages make a finished Celtic mark public and recognise it: recounting three hours of work, locating it by nearby marks, praising the maker, and fitting it into a familiar Celtic-top saying. What varies is showing labour and location versus replying with praise or a joke.
